metadata.title: Fix in toolops tab UI code to call admin tools endpoint to get list of tools.
metadata.author: Jay-IRL

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Before opening this PR please:

1. `make lint`            - passes `ruff`, `mypy`, `pylint`
2. `make test`            - all unit + integration tests green
3. `make coverage`        - ≥ 90 %
4. `make docker docker-run-ssl` or `make podman podman-run-ssl`
5. Update relevant documentation.
6. Tested with sqlite and postgres + redis.
7. Manual regression no longer fails. Ensure the UI and /version work correctly.

---

## 📌 Summary
Changes to toolops UI frontend code to call `/admin/tools` API endpoint to get list of tools. This fix is needed as the servers added in `MCP Registry` tab of UI are not shown in `toolops` tab and after the fix . Tools are shown in `toolops` tab of UI .

## 🔁 Reproduction Steps
To reproduce the issue , we can change the toolops UI code to call `/tools` API rather than calling `/admin/tools`

## 🐞 Root Cause
toolops UI code is not calling correct endpoint to get list of tools.

## 💡 Fix Description
Changes to toolops UI frontend code to call `/admin/tools` API endpoint to get list of tools

## 🧪 Verification

| Check                                 | Command              | Status |
|---------------------------------------|----------------------|--------|
| Lint suite                            | `make lint`          |        |
| Unit tests                            | `make test`          |        |
| Coverage ≥ 90 %                       | `make coverage`      |        |
| Manual regression no longer fails     | steps / screenshots  |        |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)
- [ ] Matches current MCP spec
- [ ] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] No secrets/credentials committed
